name: EmailSignatureEntries
description: A collection of EmailSignatureEntry objects that represents all the email signature entries available to Word.
remarks: Use the EmailSignatureEntries property to return the EmailSignatureEntries collection. Use the Add method of the EmailSignatureEntries object to add an email signature to Word. The following example creates a new email signature entry based on the author's name and a selection in the active document, and then it sets the new signature entry as the default email signature to use for new messages.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified EmailSignatureEntries object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of email signature entries in the collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual EmailSignatureEntry object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position or a String representing the name of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Name As String, Range As Range) As EmailSignatureEntry
methods.description: Returns an EmailSignatureEntry object that represents a new email signature entry.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the email entry.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range in the document that will be added as the signature.
